long_biography.plain_text:
Winning world championships from flyweight through super welterweight made Manny Pacquiao the first boxer to claim titles across eight divisions. His sequence of championships crossed weight categories that usually separate very different athletes, and boxing writers named him Fighter of the Decade for the 2000s.

Pacquiao turned part of his sporting platform towards organised philanthropy. As president of the Manny Pacquiao Foundation, he directs a charity built around housing, disaster relief and support for survivors of trafficking. Its partnerships channel resources towards vulnerable communities through local programmes and emergency campaigns.
